document.url_source: The "2027 - Summary of Benefits- SCAN Costco Medicare Advantage (HMO) - Alameda, San Francisco, San Mateo - English" download on the plan's page on www.scanhealthplan.com; the plan's page on Medicare Plan Finder links only the carrier's home page
document.retrieval_note: The maintainer downloaded it in a browser on 2026-10-27. The host's robots.txt (https://scan-q-002.sitecorecontenthub.cloud/robots.txt, read 2026-10-27) disallows every path but /api/public/ for automated fetching, which this check did not do.
document.read_with: pdftotext -layout and pdftotext -raw, both with -enc UTF-8; pages counted in the PDF (the document prints no page numbers). The document covers 2 plans in 2 columns, "Alameda and San Mateo Counties" and "San Francisco County"; every value here is read from the San Francisco County column, the county pbp_a_plan_geog_name gives for H5425-140-000. The -layout output interleaves the 2 columns, so values were read from the -raw output, which prints the Alameda and San Mateo value of each row before the San Francisco one. Part D on page 9 (San Francisco County); only the Part D deductible is checked.

The file's address is the printed one, pbp_a_org_website "www.scanhealthplan.com", but it has no scheme, so it is not a URI: the importer writes no contacts.website and quotes the cell in source_references (spec 4.1). Addresses are compared with the scheme, a leading "www." and the case of the host ignored.

A contradiction on a contact, not a cost share. The file gives pbp_a_curmbr_phone "(800)559-3500", which the document holds; the Summary of Benefits prints 1-833-981-5355 for members, on page 14 and in its other contact sentences, and prints 1-800-559-3500 only in the notice on page 17, as SCAN Health Plan (California) Member Services. The number printed for non-members, 1-877-870-4867, is not the file's pbp_a_prombr_phone "(888)315-7226" either, and has no field. Phone numbers are compared by their digits, without the leading 1.
